fact: The June 2025 PAREC mission aide-memoire records actions to secure a budget line for maintenance of the SIGE platform and to keep its interministerial steering body running, and states that SIGE-MINEDUB data are used to assess project progress.
title: Projet d'Appui à la Réforme de l'Education au Cameroun (PAREC-P160926) Mission d'appui à la mise en oeuvre, Aide mémoire
